setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json. One test Automotive tour created with this skill (code <tour code>), with one color and one 2D scene, whose folder accounts/<domain>/vt/<prefix>/virtualTours/<tour code>/ holds its _id. Change one setting of that tour in the app (or by PATCH) after its last push, so the folder no longer matches it. For eval 1, a folder <images folder> with one photo and one swatch image.

evals.prompt: Create a virtual tour of the car <car name> in <domain> with the images in <images folder>: <photo> is the front view in red, and <swatch> is the red color.
evals.expected_output: Lays out the tour folder with the right names, previews a create, asks for a yes, pushes through the script and gives the viewer link.
expectations: Builds accounts/<domain>/vt/<prefix>/virtualTours/<CODE>/ with _colors/external/<color>.png and external/<color>/2d_<name>.<ext>, and a _config.json with eventType Automotive and no _id
Runs scripts/vt.js preview, shows a create with one scene and one color, and waits for a yes
Pushes with scripts/vt.js push --version … --confirmed, never ./prolibu vt push or vt bulk directly
Reports the tour id and the https://<domain>/ui/spa/virtualTour/view/<id> link, and says the swatch hex is #000000 until set in the app

evals.prompt: Vuelve a subir el tour <tour code> desde su carpeta en <domain>.
evals.expected_output: Previews the update, explains in Spanish that every scene is replaced and which settings the push would reset, and pushes through the script only after the yes; colors stay linked.
expectations: Runs preview first and reports the scenes deleted and uploaded and every settingsChanged entry (the setting changed in the app goes back)
Waits for an explicit yes, then runs scripts/vt.js push with the preview's version
After the push the scene is still linked to its color (show, or scenesWithColor in the push output)

evals.prompt: Switch the theme of the virtual tour <tour code> on <domain> to cascade.
evals.expected_output: Treats it as a settings-only change: reads the tour, proposes a PATCH of config.theme through the generic helper, and does not push the scenes.
expectations: Does not run vt push or scripts/vt.js push
Shows the current theme and the change, waits for a yes, then PATCHes /v2/virtualtour/<id> with {"config":{"theme":"cascade"}} and --confirmed
Reads the tour back and confirms the theme and the unchanged scene count

evals.prompt: Descarga todos los tours virtuales de la cuenta <domain>.
evals.expected_output: Runs vt pull non-interactively into a new prefix, reports the folders, and does not push anything.
expectations: Runs ./prolibu vt pull --domain <domain> --prefix <new prefix>, with both flags
Does not follow the CLI's hint to run vt bulk and pushes nothing
Lists the tours downloaded and where they are

evals.prompt: I pushed my car tour <tour code> with the CLI and now the color picker is gone in the viewer. What happened?
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses the CLI's color drop on update from the tour's data, and offers to fix it with a preview and push through the script.
expectations: Reads the tour with scripts/vt.js show and points to scenes without a color
Explains that the CLI re-uploads swatches, the upload is refused because the file exists, and the new scenes lose their color
Offers preview + push through the script (which re-links the colors) and writes nothing without a yes
